headline: Brazil COP30 Presidency Releases Roadmaps for Energy and Forestry
summary: The Brazilian COP30 presidency presented roadmaps for ending deforestation and transitioning away from fossil fuels to guide countries in reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
why: Global climate policy frameworks and energy transition roadmaps guide long-term capital allocation, regulatory expectations, and operational strategies across energy-intensive industries.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Global energy transition roadmaps affect long-term strategic planning for fossil fuel and renewable energy producers.
